summary: The FastAPI backend implementation is well-structured and meets all expected behaviors. All API endpoints function correctly, CORS is properly configured, and error handling is comprehensive.

notes: GET /status correctly returns chunk_count and vector_dimensions
POST /query accepts query string and optional k parameter with default k=5
Query results include text and similarity fields as required
CORS middleware properly configured with allow_origins=['*']
Vector store loads from HDF5 on startup via startup_event
Clean separation of concerns with separate functions for loading vector store and initializing embedding pipeline
Proper type hints throughout the codebase
Good use of Pydantic models for request/response validation
Appropriate error handling with HTTPException for various error cases
Lazy initialization of embedding pipeline to avoid slow startup
Tests cover status endpoint, query endpoint, CORS, and frontend serving
Mocking approach properly isolates tests from external dependencies

sharedStateObservations.observation: The skill procedure should clarify that when testing CORS with TestClient, an Origin header must be provided for CORS middleware to add response headers
